definition: Marketing management plans, coordinates and evaluates the people, budgets and activities used to market offerings.
example: A manager reallocates a campaign budget after comparing acquisition results across channels.

definition: Marketing strategy defines the audiences, positioning and choices through which an offering aims to achieve market goals.
example: A startup chooses to target small clinics first and positions its software around reduced paperwork.

definition: Masonry constructs or repairs structures by laying bricks, blocks or stone, typically using mortar or carefully fitted joints.
example: A mason replaces damaged bricks while preserving the wall's pattern.

definition: Massage applies controlled manipulation of soft tissue for comfort, relaxation or other therapeutic goals.
example: A practitioner adapts a session to the client's stated comfort and restrictions.

definition: Materials testing measures a material's properties or behavior under specified conditions to assess suitability or quality.
example: A technician measures the tensile strength of samples from a production batch.

definition: Mathematica is a computational environment for symbolic and numerical mathematics, programming and visualization.
example: An analyst solves a symbolic equation and plots its solutions in a notebook.

definition: Matplotlib is a Python library for creating static, animated and interactive visualizations from data.
example: A scientist plots measured values with error bars.

definition: McAfee Personal Firewall Plus was a personal firewall product for monitoring and controlling network traffic on a computer.
example: A user reviewed application connection requests and blocked an unauthorized program.

definition: MCollective was a framework for issuing coordinated administrative commands across groups of machines.
example: An administrator queried service status across a set of managed hosts.

definition: Meal planning and preparation organize what meals are made, procure ingredients and prepare food to suit schedules and dietary needs.
example: A caregiver plans meals for the week and batches vegetables to shorten cooking time.

definition: MEAN.JS is a JavaScript application stack and project scaffold using MongoDB, Express, AngularJS and Node.js.
example: A developer starts a web application with an AngularJS interface and an Express API.
sense_note: Do not assume compatibility with current Angular from the historical name.

definition: Meat cutting portions and trims meat into specified cuts while maintaining safe handling and product quality.
example: A butcher separates a larger cut into evenly sized retail portions.

definition: Mechanical drafting creates engineering drawings that communicate dimensions, tolerances, materials and construction details of mechanical parts or assemblies.
example: A drafter adds hole positions and tolerances to a mounting plate drawing.

definition: A mechanical seal limits fluid leakage at the interface between a rotating shaft and a stationary housing.
example: A pump technician selects a seal compatible with the pumped fluid and operating conditions.

definition: Media buying selects and purchases advertising placements from publishers, platforms or networks within a campaign plan.
example: A media buyer reserves audio ads aimed at reaching commuters.

definition: Media production creates, records and assembles content for distribution through formats such as audio, video or digital publications.
example: A producer coordinates recording and editing an interview for an online series.

definition: Media relations manages communication with journalists and outlets to provide accurate information and respond to coverage requests.
example: A communications officer prepares a spokesperson to answer reporters' questions.

definition: Media Transfer Protocol is a standard for transferring and managing media objects between a host and a connected device.
example: A user imports pictures from a portable device without mounting its storage as a disk.

definition: MediatR is a .NET library for routing messages to handlers within an application.
example: An application sends an order command to its registered handler without coupling the caller to that handler directly.

definition: Medical billing and coding translate documented care into standardized codes and use those codes to prepare and manage payment claims.
example: A coder checks a diagnosis code against the encounter documentation before the billing team submits the claim.

definition: Medical device development designs, verifies and prepares devices for health applications with attention to intended use, safety and applicable requirements.
example: An engineering team tests whether a prototype meets its stated measurement accuracy.

definition: Medical device sales communicate a device's approved uses, capabilities and purchasing terms to prospective customers.
example: A representative explains device compatibility and service arrangements to a hospital purchasing team.

definition: Medical office skills support administrative work in a healthcare practice, including scheduling, patient communications and records handling.
example: A coordinator schedules a follow-up and updates the patient's contact information.

definition: Medical photography captures clinically useful images using appropriate technique, documentation and privacy practices.
example: A trained photographer records successive clinical images with consistent framing for comparison.

definition: Medical record formatting organizes health documentation into standardized, readable structures that preserve relevant clinical information.
example: A specialist converts dictated information into sections for history, examination and assessment.

definition: Medical records release verifies and fulfills authorized requests to disclose health records under applicable rules and organizational procedures.
example: A records specialist checks authorization and releases only the records covered by the request.

definition: A medical ventilator supports or replaces aspects of breathing by delivering controlled gas flow or pressure.
example: A respiratory therapist monitors how a patient responds to prescribed ventilator support.

definition: Mental health assessment collects and evaluates information about symptoms, functioning and relevant history to guide care or further evaluation.
example: A clinician uses an interview and a screening measure to decide whether a more detailed evaluation is needed.

definition: Menu planning designs a selection of dishes for a service or period while balancing nutrition, budget, availability and customer needs.
example: A school food service team rotates main dishes and includes options for documented dietary restrictions.

definition: MEP design software helps engineers model, coordinate and document mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems in buildings.
example: A coordinator checks whether a proposed ventilation duct interferes with a plumbing run.

definition: Merchandise management plans and controls the assortment, availability, pricing and presentation of goods for sale.
example: A retailer increases stock of a popular size before a seasonal promotion.

definition: Metadata management defines and maintains descriptive information about assets so they can be found, interpreted and governed.
example: A data steward records a dataset's owner, refresh schedule and variable definitions.

definition: A metal detector senses nearby metal objects by measuring their effects on an electromagnetic field.
example: A quality technician uses a detector to screen packaged food for unintended metal fragments.

definition: Meteor is a JavaScript framework for building applications across the client and server, with facilities for synchronizing data.
example: A developer builds a shared list that updates connected browser clients as items change.

definition: Meter data management collects, validates, stores and provides measurements from utility meters for billing and analysis.
example: A utility flags missing hourly readings for review before calculating a bill.

definition: The Meter Operation Code of Practice Agreement governs agreed practices for appointing and operating electricity metering services in a defined market.
example: A metering operator checks its obligations when transferring responsibility for a meter.
sense_note: Verify jurisdiction and applicable revision before citing specific requirements.

definition: MicroBlaze is a configurable soft processor core intended for integration into programmable logic devices.
example: An embedded engineer integrates a MicroBlaze processor to handle control tasks alongside FPGA logic.

definition: Microchipping implants a small electronic identifier so an animal or other subject can be identified with a compatible reader.
example: A shelter scans a found dog and checks its identifier against a registry.
sense_note: The common use is animal identification; distinguish implanting identifiers from fabricating microchips.

definition: Microsoft 365 is a subscription suite combining productivity applications and cloud services for work, communication and collaboration.
example: A team edits a shared spreadsheet while coordinating its review in a meeting.

definition: Microsoft Bookings is a scheduling tool for publishing appointment availability and managing reservations.
example: A clinic creates a booking page for consultations that reflects staff availability.
